source: docs/03-gate-rules.md, derived from PR-WKF-01 rev 3.0 gate statements, ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and ETSI TS 103 701 V1.1.1
note: Rule predicates live in application code keyed by rule id; this file carries the identity, description and failure message so a blocked gate can name what is missing. A rule change is a code change and triggers re-validation of that case under ISO/IEC 17025 7.11.2.

gates.title: Intake and contract review
gates.statement: CR-2026-XXX exists, Decision = Accept, and the written Authorization to Test is filed in 00_Contract. Without all three, no technical work begins.

machine.description: A contract_reviews row exists and is linked to the job
machine.failure: No contract review is linked to this job

machine.description: decision = 'Accept' with decided_by and decided_at set
machine.failure: The contract review decision is not Accept, or is unsigned

machine.description: authorization_to_test_path set and authorization_to_test_signed_at set
machine.failure: No signed Authorization to Test is on file

machine.description: checklist_complete = true (CHK-CTR-01)
machine.failure: The contract review checklist is incomplete

machine.description: coi_reference and confidentiality_reference both present
machine.failure: The conflict-of-interest or confidentiality instrument is missing

machine.description: decision_rule and statement_of_conformity_basis both non-empty
machine.failure: The decision rule or the statement-of-conformity basis is not recorded

machine.description: every stage 1 job_requirements row is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: Stage 1 has outstanding requirements

machine.description: if subcontracting_required then subcontract_client_approval_reference is present
machine.failure: Subcontracting is required but the client's written approval is not recorded

attestations.statement: The scope was checked against SC-LAB-01 and out-of-scope items excluded or subcontracted

gates.title: Job setup and readiness
gates.statement: JOB-2026-XXX is open, the job file exists, roles are authorized, the item and equipment are recorded as fit, and the three job documents exist with a version.

machine.description: jobs.reference allocated and job_folder_path set
machine.failure: The job has no reference or no job folder path

machine.description: job_roles holds responsible_engineer, technical_reviewer and authorized_signatory
machine.failure: A required role is unassigned on this job

machine.description: each role's competence record is Active, carries the matching authority_flag, and valid_to is null or after jobs.planned_end_date
machine.failure: A role holder has no valid competence record covering the planned job end

machine.description: no user holds both an engineer role and technical_reviewer on this job
machine.failure: The same person holds an engineer role and the reviewer role

machine.description: a job_item_records row of kind 'receipt' exists with a value and a recorder
machine.failure: The test item receipt is not recorded

machine.description: at least one job_equipment row exists, and every row with calibration_required has calibration_valid_to after jobs.planned_end_date
machine.failure: Equipment is missing, or its calibration expires before the planned job end

machine.description: all six job_environment_checks rows exist with conforms set
machine.failure: An environmental condition check is missing or unanswered

machine.description: job_documents holds rows of kind ixit, mapping and tracker, each with a version
machine.failure: A controlled job document is missing or has no version

machine.description: every stage 2 job_requirements row is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: Stage 2 has outstanding requirements

attestations.statement: The test item's condition on receipt was judged and recorded
The bench, the isolated test network and least-privilege access are in place

gates.title: DUT identification and the ICS
gates.statement: Every conditional method carries an ICS Support value, every one of the 63 methods carries an applicability decision with its basis, and every N has been challenged and accepted by the laboratory.

machine.description: job_methods holds exactly one row per method in the pinned library version (63 in rev 1.2)
machine.failure: The method set for this job is incomplete

machine.description: every job_method has ics_support in (Y, N, N-A); N-A is legal only where the method is conditional
machine.failure: A method has no ICS Support value, or carries N-A on an unconditional method. TS 103 701 clause 4.4: the Support column carries Yes, No or N/A for EVERY provision - N/A is reserved for conditional provisions the DUT cannot fulfil, No means applicable but not fulfilled. All 63 need a value, not only the 37 conditional ones.

machine.description: every job_method has applicable in (Y, N)
machine.failure: A method has no applicability decision

machine.description: every job_method has a non-empty applicability_basis
machine.failure: A method's applicability has no stated basis

machine.description: applicable = 'Y' exactly where ics_support = 'Y'
machine.failure: A method's applicability does not follow its ICS Support value

machine.description: jobs.constrained_device is not null
machine.failure: The constrained-device question is unanswered

machine.description: jobs manufacturer_model, serial_identifier and firmware_as_received are set, using an explicit 'Not provided' with a reason where the client supplied nothing
machine.failure: A DUT identification field is null rather than explicitly recorded as not provided

machine.description: a job_ixit_documents row exists
machine.failure: No IXIT document is registered for this job

machine.description: no information_gaps row with blocking = true is unresolved
machine.failure: A blocking information gap is open

machine.description: every unconditional mandatory method (m_or_r = M, conditional = false) has ics_support recorded, and where it is not 'Y' the job carries a recorded acknowledgement that overall PASS is unreachable
machine.failure: A mandatory provision is unclaimed and nothing records that overall PASS is therefore unreachable (TS 103 701 clause 4.4)

attestations.statement: Each N was challenged against its condition and against IXIT section 2, and a justification is recorded in the Detail column as TS 103 701 clause 4.4 requires

gates.title: IXIT completion and adequacy review
gates.statement: Every IXIT entry named by an applicable method is present at entry-per-mechanism granularity, with its information source recorded, and the IXIT document is approved at an issue version.

machine.description: the job_ixit_documents row has version, approved_by and approved_at set
machine.failure: The IXIT document is not approved at a version

machine.description: for every job_method with applicable = 'Y', each IXIT type named in methods.required_ixit is recorded as present
machine.failure: A required IXIT entry is missing for an applicable method

machine.description: every required IXIT entry has an information source recorded
machine.failure: An IXIT entry has no stated information source

machine.description: every information_gaps row raised against an IXIT entry is resolved or carries a stated effect_on_verdict
machine.failure: An IXIT observation is neither resolved nor carried to a verdict

machine.description: every stage 4 job_requirements row is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: Stage 4 has outstanding requirements

attestations.statement: The adequacy of the IXIT content itself was judged against the lab's adequacy rules; inadequate content carries INCONCLUSIVE rather than FAIL

gates.title: Method selection and the test plan
gates.statement: Applicability is complete for all 63 methods, verification or validation records exist for every method in use, deviations are authorized, and the Technical Reviewer has approved the plan.

machine.description: gate 3 is Passed
machine.failure: Applicability is not yet complete

machine.description: for every job_method with applicable = 'Y', a verification or validation record exists under PR-MET-01
machine.failure: A method in use has no verification or validation record

machine.description: every method_deviations row has authorized_by and authorized_at set, and authorized_at precedes any tester verdict on that method
machine.failure: A method deviation is unauthorised, or was authorised after the testing it covers

machine.description: at least one qc_activities row is planned, each with an acceptance_criterion
machine.failure: No quality control activity is planned for this job

machine.description: the test plan is approved by a user who holds technical_reviewer on this job and holds no engineer role on it
machine.failure: No independent Technical Reviewer has approved the test plan

machine.description: every stage 5 job_requirements row is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: Stage 5 has outstanding requirements

attestations.statement: The plan's setup, network topology and tooling are workable for this DUT

gates.note: RG-CMP-01 currently authorises one person for all three roles, so g5.r5 cannot be satisfied until a deputy or external reviewer exists as a competence record. That is intended. Do not add a bypass.

gates.title: Assessment execution and evidence
gates.statement: Every applicable method has a tester verdict, every verdict names at least one registered Evidence ID, every evidence file is registered once with a hash, and planned QC is logged.

machine.description: every job_method with applicable = 'Y' has verdict_tester in (PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE)
machine.failure: An applicable method has no tester verdict, or carries a value that is not a TS 103 701 test case verdict

machine.description: no job_method with applicable = 'Y' carries verdict_tester = 'N-A'
machine.failure: N-A is an ICS Support value, not a test case verdict. TS 103 701 Table 3 admits only PASS, FAIL and INCONCLUSIVE. A method that is not applicable carries applicable = 'N' and no verdict

machine.description: every job_method with verdict PASS or FAIL has at least one job_method_evidence row
machine.failure: A verdict rests on no registered evidence

machine.description: every INCONCLUSIVE verdict has non-empty tester_notes stating which required element was absent or insufficient
machine.failure: An INCONCLUSIVE verdict does not say what was missing, as TS 103 701 Table 3 requires

machine.description: every evidence row has a non-empty sha256
machine.failure: Registered evidence has no hash

machine.description: every planned qc_activities row has a result and a performed_by
machine.failure: A planned quality control activity has no recorded result

machine.description: every stage 6 job_requirements row is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: Stage 6 has outstanding requirements

attestations.statement: Each registered SHA-256 matches the file on disk
The conceptual assessment was sound for each method

gates.note: a1 and a2 cannot be checked by the system under the register-only decision. Render them as attestations, never as checks.

gates.title: Technical review
gates.statement: Every tested method carries a reviewer verdict and a Final Verdict, the tracker counts reconcile, and the reviewer has signed the review record.

machine.description: the reviewer holds technical_reviewer on this job, holds no engineer role on it, recorded no tester verdict on it and registered no evidence on it
machine.failure: The reviewer is not independent of the work

machine.description: every job_method with applicable = 'Y' has verdict_reviewer and final_verdict set
machine.failure: An applicable method has no reviewer or final verdict

machine.description: every job_method with applicable = 'N' has an applicability_basis consistent with its ics_support value
machine.failure: A non-applicable method's basis does not follow its ICS claim

machine.description: every final verdict names at least one evidence row that exists
machine.failure: A final verdict cites evidence that is not registered

machine.description: reconciliation holds: count(applicable='Y') = pass + fail + inconclusive + not_tested
machine.failure: The verdict counts do not reconcile against the applicable method count

machine.description: for every method with a verdict, the equipment used was calibration-valid on the recorded test date
machine.failure: A verdict rests on equipment that was out of calibration on the test date

machine.description: every planned QC activity has been performed
machine.failure: A planned quality control activity was not performed

machine.description: a signature exists for purpose gate_7 and every stage 7 requirement is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: The review record is unsigned or stage 7 is incomplete

machine.description: test group verdicts are derived for every provision claimed Yes, per TS 103 701 Table 2
machine.failure: Provision-level test group verdicts have not been derived from the test case verdicts

machine.description: every method with a final verdict maps to a provision key, or is explicitly excluded from the verdict chain by recorded lab policy
machine.failure: A method cannot be placed in a test group and no exclusion is recorded. CLT-SCA-FI-01 carries ts_ref 'N/A' because SCA/FI screening is scheme-defined rather than an EN 303 645 provision

attestations.statement: No PASS rests on evidence that does not support it

gates.title: Reporting
gates.statement: The report is signed by an Authorized Signatory, logged as REP-2026-XXX, and issued with the transmittal recorded.

machine.description: gate 7 is Passed
machine.failure: The technical review is not complete

machine.description: a reports row exists with reference, version and file_name
machine.failure: No report record exists

machine.description: every item in content_checklist (the ISO 7.8.2 list) is true
machine.failure: A required report content item is not present

machine.description: decision_rule_stated and opinions_marked are true, and subcontracted_results_identified is true where subcontracting was used
machine.failure: The report omits the decision rule, unmarked opinions, or unidentified subcontracted results

machine.description: signed_by holds authorized_signatory on this job with a valid competence record, and a signatures row exists for purpose report_issue
machine.failure: The report is unsigned or signed by someone without signatory authority

machine.description: the report's section 4 figures equal the computed roll-up exactly
machine.failure: The report's counts do not match the system's roll-up

machine.description: no applicable method remains at NOT TESTED
machine.failure: An applicable method has not been tested

machine.description: the overall verdict is derived per TS 103 701 Table 1 from the test group verdicts
machine.failure: No overall verdict has been derived

machine.description: issued_at and transmittal_reference are set
machine.failure: The report has not been issued or the transmittal is not recorded

machine.description: where a method excluded from the verdict chain carries FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE, the report states that result explicitly
machine.failure: An excluded method failed and the report does not say so. Exclusion from the overall verdict must not make a failure invisible

attestations.statement: Every placeholder was replaced, Annex T removed, and the TLP marking is consistent on cover, header and footer

gates.title: Closure
gates.statement: Item disposed of as agreed, job file archived with retention applied, access revoked, Job_Register Status = Done.

machine.description: a job_item_records row of kind 'return_or_disposal' exists with date and recipient
machine.failure: The test item's return or disposal is not recorded

machine.description: jobs.archive_location and jobs.retention_period are set
machine.failure: The job archive location or retention period is not recorded

machine.description: jobs.access_revoked_at is set and every job access grant is revoked
machine.failure: Job access has not been revoked

machine.description: jobs.client_feedback_requested_at is set
machine.failure: Client feedback was not requested

machine.description: jobs.status = 'Done' and actual_end_date is set
machine.failure: The job is not marked Done

machine.description: no open nonconformities row blocks this job
machine.failure: An open nonconformity still blocks this job

machine.description: every stage 9 job_requirements row is Complete or N/A
machine.failure: Stage 9 has outstanding requirements

attestations.statement: Client data held outside the archive has been securely deleted

gates.title: Nonconforming work
gates.statement: The decision on affected work is recorded, the client informed where an issued report was affected, resumption authorized in writing, and the NC closed with an outcome.

machine.description: affected_work_decision is recorded
machine.failure: The decision on affected work is not recorded

machine.description: where a report was issued, client_informed is true and report_recalled_or_amended is recorded
machine.failure: An affected report was not recalled or amended, or the client was not informed

machine.description: resumption_authorized_by and resumption_authorized_at are set before work resumes
machine.failure: Work resumed without written authorization

machine.description: closed_at, closed_by and outcome are set
machine.failure: The nonconformity has no recorded outcome

machine.description: process_control_logged is true (NC_Work_Log)
machine.failure: The nonconformity is not logged in Process_Control

gates.note: Not a sequence gate. An NC with blocks_stage_number set holds that stage until closed_at is set.

gates.title: Complaints
gates.statement: The outcome is decided by people not involved in the original activity, communicated formally, and the complaint closed.

machine.description: acknowledged_at is set
machine.failure: The complaint was not acknowledged

machine.description: investigator_id is not any job_roles.user_id on the related job
machine.failure: The investigator was involved in the work complained about (ISO 7.9.5)

machine.description: decision_maker_id differs from investigator_id and is not any job_roles.user_id on the related job
machine.failure: The decision maker is not independent (ISO 7.9.6)

machine.description: decision and communicated_at are set
machine.failure: The complaint outcome was not decided or not communicated

machine.description: closed_at is set and the complaint is logged in Process_Control (Complaints_Log)
machine.failure: The complaint is not closed or not logged

gates.note: Not a sequence gate. Independence is enforced on save, not only at closure.

evaluation_contract.fail_closed: A rule whose predicate is not implemented marks the gate Unevaluable, never Passed.
evaluation_contract.attestations: Signed separately from machine rules and never rendered as checks. A gate with all machine rules satisfied but an unsigned attestation does not pass.
evaluation_contract.blocked_reasons: Each failing rule contributes its id and failure message, so a blocked gate names conditions rather than reporting a generic failure.

notes_on_the_method_library.one_test_case_per_group: In Mapping rev 1.2 every test group holds exactly one test case: 62 provisions, 62 groups, all of size one. Table 2's precedence logic therefore cannot aggregate anything against this library and the derivation is an identity mapping. Implement Table 2 properly anyway - a later revision may carry several test cases per provision - and assert the one-per-provision property against the seeded data so a revision that changes it fails loudly instead of silently altering verdicts.
notes_on_the_method_library.unmappable_method: CLT-SCA-FI-01 carries the literal ts_ref 'N/A'. SCA / FI screening is scheme-defined, not an EN 303 645 provision, so it has no provision key and cannot sit in a test group. Do not invent one: see the recorded position in docs/03-gate-rules.md.
